old_problem: UCE severity is contradicted by a Correctable step label, while the consuming access, poison delivery, physical slot, allowed fatal/contained outcome and post-recovery disarm are all undefined.
disposition_reason: Title, Criteria and errortype1 support UCE, but cannot supply the proprietary implicit trigger or deterministic result. The consuming access and poison state decide whether a process signal, machine check, reset or fatal loss occurs. ED-15 rejects `may` as a PASS oracle and ED-16 requires recovery/disarm before arming. This remains Pending/BLOCKED until AMD and the platform owner publish the complete transaction.

Preserved implicit one-shot UCE and all-slot coverage independently of CE, persistent and userspace modes.
Resolved only the copied Correctable label in favor of three concordant UCE indicators.

test_case.test_name: AMD implicit one-shot uncorrectable DRAM event per slot
test_case.purpose: For each mapped slot, consume exactly one implicit UCE and verify the signed poison/containment outcome, bounded recovery and inactive injector afterward.
required_package: Data-poisoning state and owned synthetic consume action
Deterministic process/MCA/reset/fatal outcome matrix and timeouts
OOB recovery, poison cleanup and full restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not arm. After approval, select one mapped slot, capture status/counters, arm errortype1 once, perform the exact documented synthetic access under continuous OOB capture, match the result to the outcome matrix, recover and clean poison, prove a safe second access causes no injection, confirm disarm and restore before another slot.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one attributable UCE occurs at the intended slot and follows the approved containment path; recovery completes within deadline, no residual poison or armed state remains and later negative access is clean.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists until trigger, poison and outcome semantics are authoritative. Correctable evidence, tool PASS alone, optional fatality, repeated event or uncertain disarm/cleanup cannot pass.
safety_gate: Backed-up isolated ECC SUT with independent OOB power/reimage.
No arm until target, trigger, poison and allowed outcome are signed.
One slot only; abort on wrong target, repeated UCE, outcome outside matrix, boot loop or lost console.
No automatic reset, retry or next-slot progression.
expected_evidence: One-shot trigger plus continuous OOB/OS/BMC record
Negative second access, disarm, poison cleanup, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: The missing containment contract must define process, reset/power/reimage and poison-removal paths plus how to clear a residual arm. Execution is blocked until those recovery branches are approved.
